snapshot.name: session_match_requests
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, session_player_id, format, status, requested_at, decided_at, match_id, revision::text AS revision, updated_at FROM session_match_requests ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: matches
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, match_no, state, format, queue_position, origin, manual_protected, generation_id, source_operation_id, placed_at, started_at, ended_at, removed_at, created_at, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM matches ORDER BY session_id, match_no, id

snapshot.name: match_court_usage
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, match_id, court_id, acquired_at, released_at, acquire_operation_id, release_operation_id FROM match_court_usage ORDER BY match_id, court_id

snapshot.name: active_court_holds
snapshot.sql: SELECT court_id, session_id, match_id, held_at FROM active_court_holds ORDER BY court_id

snapshot.name: active_player_holds
snapshot.sql: SELECT session_player_id, session_id, match_id, player_id, held_at FROM active_player_holds ORDER BY session_player_id

snapshot.name: session_drop_out_notices
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, session_id, session_player_id, player_id, status, decision, created_at, closed_at, closed_by_device_id FROM session_drop_out_notices ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: queue_sessions
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, state, revision::text AS revision, queue_revision::text AS queue_revision, finalized_at, record_games, updated_at FROM queue_sessions ORDER BY id

snapshot.name: club_session_reservations
snapshot.sql: SELECT club_id, session_id, acquired_at FROM club_session_reservations ORDER BY session_id

snapshot.name: session_finalizations
snapshot.sql: SELECT session_id, club_id, command_id, state, stage, failed_stage, failure_code, stream_manifest, encode(manifest_digest, 'hex') AS manifest_digest, accepted_session_revision::text AS accepted_session_revision, policy_version_id, started_at, committed_at, completed_at, encode(facts_digest, 'hex') AS facts_digest, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM session_finalizations ORDER BY session_id

snapshot.name: player_match_facts
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, session_id, match_id, session_player_id, club_player_id, player_id_at_finalization, played_at, format, team, winning_team, full_participation, standard_match, skill_level_snapshot_id, ARRAY(SELECT x FROM unnest(partner_entry_ids) x ORDER BY x) AS partner_entry_ids, ARRAY(SELECT x FROM unnest(opponent_entry_ids) x ORDER BY x) AS opponent_entry_ids, team_a_score, team_b_score, fact_version, created_at FROM player_match_facts ORDER BY session_id, match_id, session_player_id

snapshot.name: club_session_player_summaries
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, session_id, session_player_id, club_player_id, player_id_snapshot, full_games, standard_games, fun_games, wins, losses, skill_level_snapshot_id, summary_version, projected_at FROM club_session_player_summaries ORDER BY session_id, session_player_id

snapshot.name: session_result_snapshots
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, club_id, session_id, version, calculation_version, standings, awards, off_day, ARRAY(SELECT x FROM unnest(baseline_session_ids) x ORDER BY x) AS baseline_session_ids, generated_at FROM session_result_snapshots ORDER BY session_id, version

snapshot.name: projection_jobs
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, kind, kind_version, source_type, source_finalization_id, target_player_id, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, locked_at, last_error_code, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM projection_jobs ORDER BY source_finalization_id, kind

snapshot.name: player_rank_current
snapshot.sql: SELECT player_id, skill_level_id, numeric_rank::text AS numeric_rank, state, explanation_code, assessment_component::text AS assessment_component, performance_component::text AS performance_component, input_counts, policy_version_id, algorithm_version, window_start, window_end, calculated_at, input_watermark::text AS input_watermark, next_recheck_at, recent_standard_match_count, last_valid_played_at, leaderboard_eligible, updated_at, revision::text AS revision FROM player_rank_current ORDER BY player_id

snapshot.name: rank_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT n.player_id, n.kind, n.title, n.body, n.target, n.source_type, n.source_id, (SELECT j.kind FROM projection_jobs j WHERE j.id = n.source_id) AS source_job_kind, n.created_at, n.read_at FROM player_notifications n WHERE n.kind = 'rank' ORDER BY n.player_id, n.source_id
